headline: The excitement after the debut has faded. Anthropic shares below the line
summary: A BIDS-BCI survey found Bangladeshi factory output down 0.4% year on year. Of factories surveyed, 93% cited energy shortages as a top constraint, while machinery investment plunged 94%.
why: Bangladesh is one of the world's largest garment exporters, so industrial output and energy supply shape its export earnings. Investors track these indicators for the outlook of its manufacturing sector.
original_headline: Emocje po debiucie już opadły. Akcje Anthropic pod kreską
